notes: No Slovenia-specific food-truck ordering tool found. Two eligible: Anolla (Slovenian-language booking system with food pre-orders and takeaway orders; free plan '0€' with no period stated, so period null; paid features usage-based with no amounts; focus set food_truck on a street-food / festival-catering quote but it is mainly a reservation tool) and SumUp Spletna trgovina (pos; generic online shop with in-store pickup, 0 € monthly + 2,50 % per transaction; no food wording). Looked at but not recorded (they fail the 'serves Slovenia' test or show no evidence, not the ordering rule): DISH Order (dish.co/SI/... returns 404, no Slovenia site); UpMenu (upmenu.com/sl/ returns 404); Restaumatic (has a Slovenian site restaumatic.com/sl/ with 'Strankam omogočite, da oddajo in plačajo naročila prek spleta.' but no pickup / order-ahead sentence and no price, only 'prilagojeno ponudbo'; /sl/price-list/ and /sl/payments 404); Odoo sl_SI restaurant-features (English text, no online ordering/pickup). Zettle not checked (no sign it sells in Slovenia). Delivery marketplaces (Wolt, Glovo, Bolt Food, ehrana) excluded. The page reader capped quotes at 125 chars, so Anolla quotes are verbatim excerpts.
